question.wording: Do the benefits on this Form SSA-1099 belong to the taxpayer or spouse (rather than, say, a child paid in a parent's name)?

options.label: Yes — the taxpayer's or the spouse's
No — they belong to someone else

default.because: Benefits on a statement in the taxpayer's name are theirs unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: Benefits are included in the taxable income (to the extent they are taxable) of the person who has the legal right to receive the benefits.
